pages.text: $(bold)Hemp Seeds$() are the foundation of everything in Smokeleaf Industries. Without them, you cannot progress.$(br)$(br)Break $(bold)short grass$() or $(bold)tall grass$() anywhere in the world for a chance to receive Hemp Seeds. No special tools needed — just punch grass!$(br)$(br)Once you have seeds, plant them on tilled farmland near water. They grow through $(bold)11 age stages (0–10)$() and must fully mature before harvesting.
Drops from short and tall grass. Plant on farmland. Harvest at age 10 for Hemp Leaf, Hemp Fibers, and more seeds.

$(bold)First Steps:$()$(br)1. Break grass → get Hemp Seeds$(br)2. Till dirt + plant seeds$(br)3. Wait for full growth (age 10)$(br)4. Harvest drops: Hemp Leaf, Hemp Fibers, Seeds$(br)$(br)Hemp Leaf + a Book crafts your $(bold)Smokeleaf Guide$() — this very book!$(br)$(br)$(bold)Tobacco Seeds$() also drop from grass and unlock the Joint and other tobacco recipes.
